newsitem.title: USA: VF Corp, Maidenform terminate merger talks.
newsitem.headline: VF Corp, Maidenform terminate merger talks.

text.p: VF Corp and Maidenform Worldwide Inc jointly announced Thursday that they had agreed to terminate their talks concerning a previously announced plan for VF to acquire Maidenform.
Officials of the two companies were not available to explain reasons for the decision.
VF, maker of Lee and Wrangler jeans, announced its plan to acquire Maidenform, the largest U.S. maker of women's intimate apparel, on March 25.
Maidenform owns a 92 percent stake in NCC Industries Inc, a maker of full-figure intimate apparel.
